requirement.original: Three critical bugs in the travel plan HTML page (generate-html-interactive.py): Bug 1 - Meals: All restaurant options must be PARALLEL EQUAL CARDS. Bug 2 - Shopping: Show individual brand stores, NOT shopping malls. Bug 3 - Timeline View: Rendering is broken with huge empty gaps.
requirement.clarified: Fix three rendering bugs in generate-html-interactive.py: (1) Restructure meal rendering so primary + alternative restaurants appear as equal parallel cards instead of 1 card + text list, (2) Parse shopping mall notes_base to extract individual brand stores as separate cards, (3) Fix Timeline view layout calculations that cause gaps and missing elements.
requirement.what: Fix 3 bugs in the HTML generator: meal card equality, shopping brand extraction, timeline layout
requirement.why: Current rendering shows meals hierarchically (1 primary + text alternatives), shopping as mall names instead of brands, and timeline with broken gaps -- all degrading user experience

included: Shopping Python merge logic with notes_base parsing (lines 602-635)
excluded: Overall page design system or color scheme
Adding new data fields to schema

success_criteria: All meal options (primary + alternatives) render as equal-sized parallel cards
Shopping section shows individual brand stores extracted from notes_base, not mall names
Timeline view renders all activities without gaps or missing elements
constraints: Must not break existing data format compatibility
Must work with the embedded React (no external build system)

bug_1_meals.symptom: Meal alternatives render as small text items under 'Also try' heading instead of equal cards
bug_1_meals.root_cause: JSX lines 2041-2071 render alternatives in a subordinate div with 32px thumbnails and single-line text. The meal section grid (line 2007) uses repeat(3, 1fr) for 3 meal types (breakfast/lunch/dinner), not for multiple options within a meal type. Alternatives are appended INSIDE each meal type card rather than being siblings.
bug_1_meals.root_cause_commit: N/A - original design decision, not a regression
bug_1_meals.why_introduced: Original design treated alternatives as secondary suggestions, not equal choices
bug_1_meals.why_problematic: User wants all restaurant options presented equally for decision-making
bug_1_meals.fix_approach: Restructure meal section to iterate per meal type, then render ALL options (primary + alternatives) as equal cards in a horizontal scrolling container. Remove the subordinate alternatives div.

bug_2_shopping.symptom: Shopping section shows mall names (e.g., 'Wangfujing Yintai in88') instead of individual brand stores
bug_2_shopping.root_cause: Python merge logic (lines 602-635) passes shopping entries as-is from shopping.json, which contains mall-level entries. The notes_base field contains structured brand information (e.g., '[FAST FASHION] UR 2F -- description | UNIQLO 1F/2F') but this is never parsed into individual entries. The JSX (lines 2176-2206) renders whatever the Python gives it.
bug_2_shopping.root_cause_commit: N/A - data was always mall-level, parsing was never implemented
bug_2_shopping.why_introduced: Shopping agent outputs mall-level data with brands in notes_base text
bug_2_shopping.why_problematic: User wants to see individual brand stores as separate browsable cards
bug_2_shopping.fix_approach: Add a Python method to parse notes_base structured format into individual brand entries. In _merge_day_data(), expand each mall's notes_base into N brand cards. Each brand card inherits the mall's coordinates, time, and has the mall name as context. JSX renders the expanded brand list.

bug_3_timeline.symptom: Timeline view has huge empty gaps and elements not rendering correctly
bug_3_timeline.root_cause: Multiple interacting issues: (1) hH constant (80px/hour) creates proportional layout where short activities (2-15 min) get minimum 24px height but the time grid stays at 80px/hour, causing visual mismatch. (2) Travel segments with 2-minute durations (e.g., walk 14:00-14:02) overlap with the next activity at 14:00, creating stacking. (3) The computeColumnLayout greedy algorithm assigns separate columns to overlapping items, but the visual width calculation doesn't account for the total timeline height expanding due to minimum heights. (4) Items with time 00:00-00:00 (like N/A breakfast) may create negative positioning from firstH.
bug_3_timeline.root_cause_commit: N/A - accumulation of layout edge cases
bug_3_timeline.why_introduced: Timeline was designed for 30-60 minute activities; 2-minute walks and overlapping time ranges expose layout bugs
bug_3_timeline.why_problematic: Large gaps between activities make the timeline unusable
bug_3_timeline.fix_approach: Three fixes: (1) Filter out 00:00-00:00 entries and very short travel segments that overlap with their destination activity. (2) Adjust minimum height logic so short activities don't create gaps. (3) Consider collapsing travel segments into transition indicators rather than full timeline entries.
